description: The file implements a translation memory system with data structures for translation entries, functions to load, access, modify, and save the translation memory, stored as JSON lines in a file.

methods.name: LoadTranslationMemory
methods.description: Loads the translation memory from a file, reading JSON lines and unmarshaling into TMEntry structs.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a translation entry by cache key, only returning if the translation is non-empty.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a translation entry in the memory.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the entire translation memory to the file, writing entries as JSON lines.
